## What this session covers

*tktk — one short paragraph a participant reads before deciding what to bring to it.*

This session covers the limits of plagiarism detection, equity concerns, and how to write
a responsible-use policy for your own classroom.

## The detection problem

*tktk — the evidence on AI-detection tools, false-positive rates, and who bears the cost of
being wrongly flagged. This is the part teachers most often get bad information about.*

## Equity

*tktk — access differences, language background, disability accommodation, and how
detection-based policy lands unevenly.*

## Writing a responsible-use policy

*tktk — the practical takeaway. A teacher should leave able to draft or revise a policy for
their own classroom.*
